name: dogfood-quality-metrics-drift-gate-app

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
